# kcore Provider

Use this provider with the [`kcorehypervisor/kcore`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/kcorehypervisor/kcore/latest) Terraform Registry source.

The provider connects to the controller **gRPC** endpoint. Configure **mTLS** (`tls_cert_path`, `tls_key_path`, and optionally `tls_ca_path`) for production clusters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    kcore = {
      source  = "kcorehypervisor/kcore"
      version = "0.3.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "kcore" {
  controller_address = var.controller_address

  # mTLS (recommended)
  tls_cert_path = var.tls_cert_path
  tls_key_path  = var.tls_key_path
  tls_ca_path   = var.tls_ca_path

  # Dev only — do not use in production
  # insecure = true
}
```

Schema attributes are listed below. See also the [examples/](https://github.com/kcorehypervisor/terraform-provider-kcore/tree/main/examples) directory in the repository.
